errors.error_description: The combinational block updating serial_in_mux is sensitive only to shift_en but reads dir, serial_in, and parity signals, causing a sensitivity list mismatch.
The sub-module tap_slice port .d expects a 4-bit vector but is connected to a 5-bit concatenation, creating a port width mismatch at instantiation.
The sequential control uses case-equality (===) to test the load signal, which is a misuse of operators in synthesizable RTL.
The internal signal debug_unused is declared but never driven or read, resulting in an unused signal.
